reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 23 May order-form deadline for Thornbury Cloth Co. from anything she can see. There are no Thornbury files in the share, and Thornbury hasn't come up in #central-team.

I also pointed out that today is 14 Oct 2026, so "23 May" has either already passed or means 23 May 2027. Either way it may be old information or misheard. I suggested she get the date in writing from her Thornbury contact or check with whoever owns the account. Once it's confirmed, I can add it to calendars or set up a reminder.

I saved a note for this channel recording the date as unconfirmed, so it isn't treated as a real deadline later.
